::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/events"}
#docs
## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of events to return. |
| `webhook_status[in]` | `string` | no | Comma-separated webhook_status values: not_configured (no endpoint received it), pending (a delivery is queued or retrying), failed (a delivery gave up), delivered (every delivery settled). Also `webhook_status[is\|is_not\|not_in]`. The same worst-wins rollup the list prints; imported events are always not_configured. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `event`. One of `event`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The event id. |
| `data.type` | `string` | The event type. |
| `data.event_type` | `string` | The event type. The same as `type`. |
| `data.source` | `string` | What caused the event. |
| `data.actor` | `string` | Who or what caused the event. |
| `data.user` | `string` | The same as `actor`. |
| `data.resource` | `object` | The record that the event is about. |
| `data.occurred_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the event happened. |
| `data.trace_id` | `string` | The id of the request or job that caused the event. |
| `data.api_version` | `string` | The API version that the event payload follows. |
| `data.imported` | `boolean` | Present and true for an event that came from an import. |
| `data.webhook_status` | `string` | The delivery state across all endpoints. One of `not_configured`, `pending`, `failed`, `delivered`. |
| `data.data` | `object` | The event payload. |
| `data.content` | `object` | The same as `data`. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True if more items follow this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Opaque cursor; pass it as `starting_after` to read the next page. |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Count of the filtered set. First page only. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | List of events |

curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/events?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
